description: DDT 48 - PLAN DE PREVENTION DES RISQUES INONDATION LOT AVAL is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by lozere.gouv.fr. The COVADIS data standard for risk prevention plans includes all the technical and organisational specifications for the digital storage of geographical data represented in the risk prevention plans (RPPs). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "DDT 48 — FLOOD RISK PREVENTION PLAN DOWNSTREAM LOT" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include saint pierre de nogaret, ppr, données ouvertes, plan de prévention, chirac, lozere. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
